contract: A null key, an older value, aborted transaction data, and a resolved abort marker are removed from the stable prefix.
The last ordinary value keeps its producer id. A last tombstone stays until its delete horizon and is removed after that horizon.
An undecided transaction holds the suffix, so its record is copied unchanged.
A staged plan that is not published is discarded on reopen. The previously published generation remains, with no invented value and no missing retained offset.
A plan larger than the scratch budget fails before publication and leaves the source view intact.
limits: The ordinary batch planner still rejects transactional, control, and idempotent Kafka batches. This cleaner accepts only records the caller has already classified.
It does not replace the segment generation swap in segments.rs and it does not parse Kafka record batches.
The journal format is the local PLCMP01 plan-then-commit record.
Not a production qualification and not a fastest-server claim.
